title: Fight / Fight (Plasticman Remix)
label: Terrorhythm Recordings

type.basis: Evidence specimen. No published description of its sound was found, so every character is drafted.

context.text: Terrorhythm was founded in 2002 by Plastician; TERR001 was Mark One's 'Fight' with a Plasticman remix.
In 2003 Plastician had a weekly Rinse FM slot alongside Mark One (MRK1) and Virus Syndicate.
Mark One later recorded as MRK1; the MRK1 article lists 'Fight' as a 2003 single on 'Terro Rhythm'.
Plastician describes 'Fight' as a collaboration with Mark One on Terrorhythm.

rels.other: Fight (Plasticman Remix), on the same release

uncertainty: No published description of the sound was found. The format ('12"') is inferred from Terrorhythm being a vinyl label and from the A/B remix pairing; Discogs could not be opened to confirm it. The MRK1 article was read on an mdwiki.org mirror of Wikipedia.
tracklist: Original plus Plasticman remix. First release on Plasticman's Terrorhythm label.
